values.note: Online on Campspot or by phone at (423) 884-6280. Check-in 1 pm, check-out noon. Full payment at booking; cancellations 14+ days out are refunded less a $15 fee, 5-14 days out less one night, under 5 days not at all.

note: Drive-in RV campground on a wooded Tellico Lake peninsula near Vonore, run by the Tellico Reservoir Development Agency (TRDA, a Tennessee state agency) on former TVA land: gated entrance, swim beach, boat slips for rent and a fishing pier, with the public boat ramp next door. The park describes its lakefront spaces as tent sites; the RV sites are in the woods. --Claude
